presentation.label: SAMPLE LAYER
presentation.summary: A filter and a decay for the sample alone, on a page after SMPL's waveform, so the sample layered on an analog drum can be shaped apart from it.
presentation.overview: Sample Layer shapes a track's sample before it reaches its DAC, leaving the analog machine as it is. Press SMPL until the SMPL LAYER page shows, after the waveform: FRQ, RES and TYP (OFF, LP, BP, HP) set a 12 dB per octave filter on the sample, and DEC gives the sample a decay of its own, started at each trig, from 4 ms to 3 s or INF. The AMP envelope and the analog filter still shape the whole sound. The settings are kept with the sound.
highlights: A page after SMPL's waveform: the waveform view stays where it was.
LP, BP or HP on the sample alone, with resonance.
DEC: a decay for the sample, under the AMP envelope, restarted at every trig.
TYP OFF and DEC INF leave the sample exactly as stock plays it.
usage: Put a sample on a BD track with an analog machine. Press SMPL until SMPL LAYER shows.
Set TYP to HP and turn FRQ up: the sample becomes a click on top of the analog body.
Turn DEC down: the sample is only the attack of the hit while the analog part rings on.

access.location: SMPL key, pressed until the SMPL LAYER page shows (after the waveform).
steps: Select a voice track with a sample.
Press SMPL: the SAMPLE page, then the waveform, then SMPL LAYER.

controls.name: FRQ
controls.doc: The filter's frequency, 20 Hz to 18 kHz. Its text is stock FILTER FRQ's.

controls.name: RES
controls.doc: Resonance, 0 to 15: Q 0.5 to 4, up to +12 dB at FRQ.

controls.name: TYP
controls.doc: OFF, LP, BP or HP, 12 dB per octave.

controls.name: DEC
controls.doc: The sample's own decay from each trig, 0 (4 ms) to 126 (3 s); 127 is INF, no decay.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 on Modwerk's base only (it follows the base's AMP record for the trigs).
The settings cannot be p-locked or reached over MIDI: they live outside the sound's parameters.
40 of the sound's 56 storage bits: a set whose sound fields need more will not link (Voice DAC takes 39, LFO RND 16).
A change reaches a playing voice within about 50 ms.

claims: ui:FUNC + SMPL: SAMPLE ENGINE list (stock: sample list, still on knob D)
ui:UP, DOWN, YES, NO and knobs A-H while the SAMPLE ENGINE list is open
audio:sample stream before the voice mixer

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.
